entities.name: Heiko Yamazaki
entities.description: Human samurai of the Asari Uprisers on Kamigawa, trusted advisor to Risona.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Movement Heiko joined and fought for.

entities.name: Norika
entities.description: Heiko's cousin and former childhood friend, injured by a kami.

entities.name: Eiganjo merge gate
entities.description: Site of the accident that injured Norika.

entities.name: Chiye
entities.description: Upriser cook Heiko fell in love with.

entities.name: Sokenzanshi
entities.description: Mountainous city where Heiko is stationed.

events.summary: At eight, an accident at the Eiganjo merge gate causes Heiko's cousin Norika to be injured by a kami.
events.quote: an accident at the Eiganjo merge gate caused her cousin Norika to be injured by a kami

events.summary: Blaming herself, Heiko leaves the Imperial Palace and joins the Asari Uprisers.
events.quote: she left the Imperial Palace after her eighteenth birthday

events.summary: At twenty Heiko falls in love with the Upriser cook Chiye.
events.quote: she fell in love with the Upriser cook Chiye

events.summary: Stationed in Sokenzanshi, Heiko repels Imperial attempts to stabilize their hold and is forced to confront Norika.
events.quote: was forced to confront her cousin and former childhood friend, Norika

relations.note: She fell in love with her.
relations.quote: she fell in love with the Upriser cook Chiye
